s0301.literal: Monks and Daoists who engage in commerce were ordered to pay taxes.
s0301.idiomatic: Monks and Daoists who engage in commerce were ordered to pay taxes.

s0302.literal: Whenever princes and imperial sons-in-law made requisitions, officials who dispensed without imperial command were to be punished and dismissed.
s0302.idiomatic: Whenever princes and imperial sons-in-law made requisitions, officials who dispensed without imperial command were to be punished and dismissed.

s0303.literal: An edict directed that on all routes, when Uighurs and Khamil people sued one another, cases went to the protectorate office; when they sued commoners, local officials were authorized to decide exclusively.
s0303.idiomatic: An edict directed that on all routes, when Uighurs and Khamil people sued one another, cases went to the protectorate office; when they sued commoners, local officials were authorized to decide exclusively.

s0304.literal: On jiawu day an edict directed: "The court, princes, and imperial sons-in-law each have designated households for presenting captured hawks and falcons; from now on those who are not falconers yet use relay transport to push forward in person shall be punished.
s0304.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict directed, "The court, princes, and imperial sons-in-law each have designated households for presenting captured hawks and falcons; from now on those who are not falconers yet use relay transport to push forward in person shall be punished.

s0305.literal: " On gengzi day because Yongping, Qing, Cang, and Liulin garrison-farm fields suffered flooding, overdue rents and grain lent to the people were all not collected.
s0305.idiomatic: On gengzi day because Yongping, Qing, Cang, and Liulin garrison-farm fields suffered flooding, overdue rents and grain lent to the people were all not collected.

s0306.literal: On dingwei day Imperial Academy students were assigned to teach separately at Shangdu.
s0306.idiomatic: On dingwei day Imperial Academy students were assigned to teach separately at Shangdu.

s0307.literal: Prince of Xiping Aoluchi, Hetai, and their subjects were granted ten thousand ingots of notes; Duoyersi and other relay households two thousand two hundred ingots of notes and more than three hundred ninety taels of silver.
s0307.idiomatic: Prince of Xiping Aoluchi, Hetai, and their subjects were granted 10,000 ingots of notes; Duoyersi and other relay households 2,200 ingots of notes and more than 390 taels of silver.

s0308.literal: Yidu Linqu and Dezhou Qihe suffered locusts.
s0308.idiomatic: Yidu Linqu and Dezhou Qihe suffered locusts.

s0309.literal: Fifth month, guichou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0309.idiomatic: Fifth month, guichou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

s0310.literal: On xinyou day property confiscated from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan in Jiangnan was placed under the Central Regency Directorate.
s0310.idiomatic: On xinyou day property confiscated from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan in Jiangnan was placed under the Central Regency Directorate.

s0311.literal: On jisi day for merit in pacifying the Song and Longji, princes Totoq and Yijilidai, pingzhang Chuangwu'er, and others were granted silver, notes, gold, brocade, and jade belts; officials of Dali Gold Teeth, Qujing, Wusa, and Wumeng pacification commissions received silver and notes in graded amounts.
s0311.idiomatic: On jisi day for merit in pacifying the Song and Longji, princes Totoq and Yijilidai, pingzhang Chuangwu'er, and others were granted silver, notes, gold, brocade, and jade belts; officials of Dali Gold Teeth, Qujing, Wusa, and Wumeng pacification commissions received silver and notes in graded amounts.

s0312.literal: On renshen day the Fujian Branch Salt Transport Commission was abolished and its annual levies merged into the pacification commission; central secretariat officials said: "The Wu and Song rivers are actually the ancient river mouth; tidal silting has long blocked them, burying more than one hundred li of fertile fields; moreover sea transport also issues from there; tenants should perform corvée for fifteen thousand men to dredge, with fifteen shi of rent remitted per year; a mobile directorate of waterways should also be established to oversee the schedule.
s0312.idiomatic: On renshen day the Fujian branch salt transport commission was abolished and its annual levies merged into the pacification commission; central secretariat officials said, "The Wu and Song rivers are actually the ancient river mouth; tidal silting has long blocked them, burying more than 100 li of fertile fields; moreover sea transport also issues from there; tenants should perform corvée for 15,000 men to dredge, with 15 shi of rent remitted per year; a mobile directorate of waterways should also be established to oversee the schedule.

s0314.literal: Relay vouchers of all princes were recalled.
s0314.idiomatic: Relay vouchers of all princes were recalled.

s0315.literal: On guiyou day the official ranks of seventeen granaries including Guantao were fixed: those storing one hundred thousand shi or more of grain were rank 7b; fifty thousand shi or more rank 8a.
s0315.idiomatic: On guiyou day the official ranks of 17 granaries including Guantao were fixed: those storing 100,000 shi or more of grain were rank 7b; 50,000 shi or more rank 8a.

s0316.literal: Less than fifty thousand was rank 8b; on gengchen day because last year Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered earthquakes and more than one thousand four hundred monastery and temple buildings were destroyed and more than one thousand Daoists killed or injured, an order directed relief.
s0316.idiomatic: Less than 50,000 was rank 8b; on gengchen day because last year Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered earthquakes and more than 1,400 monastery and temple buildings were destroyed and more than 1,000 Daoists killed or injured, an order directed relief.

s0317.literal: That month Lingxian in Weizhou, Yangqu in Taiyuan, Tiancheng and Huai'an in Longxing, and Baideng in Datong suffered heavy wind, rain, and hail that damaged crops; people died.
s0317.idiomatic: That month Lingxian in Weizhou, Yangqu in Taiyuan, Tiancheng and Huai'an in Longxing, and Baideng in Datong suffered heavy wind, rain, and hail that damaged crops; people died.

s0318.literal: Jun and Hua in Daming, Qihe in Dezhou suffered continuous rain; Xiangfu and Taikang in Bianliang, Huojia in Weihui, and Yangwu in Taiyuan — rivers overflowed.
s0318.idiomatic: Jun and Hua in Daming, Qihe in Dezhou suffered continuous rain; Xiangfu and Taikang in Bianliang, Huojia in Weihui, and Yangwu in Taiyuan — rivers overflowed.

s0319.literal: Sixth month, guiwei day: the wine prohibition in Karakorum was lifted and a wine-tax intendancy was established.
s0319.idiomatic: Sixth month, guiwei day: the wine prohibition in Karakorum was lifted and a wine-tax intendancy was established.

s0320.literal: On dingyou day the sorcerer Li Caolu of Runing and others falsely claimed to have received heavenly books and deceived the masses; when the affair was exposed they were executed.
s0320.idiomatic: On dingyou day the sorcerer Li Caolu of Runing and others falsely claimed to have received heavenly books and deceived the masses; when the affair was exposed they were executed.

s0321.literal: Yijin suffered locusts; Xiangfu, Kaifeng, and Chenzhou in Bianliang suffered continuous rain — field rents were remitted.
s0321.idiomatic: Yijin suffered locusts; Xiangfu, Kaifeng, and Chenzhou in Bianliang suffered continuous rain — field rents were remitted.

s0322.literal: Fufeng, Qishan, and Baoji counties suffered drought; Wusa, Wumeng, Yizhou, Mangbu, Dongchuan, and other routes suffered famine and epidemic — all were given relief.
s0322.idiomatic: Fufeng, Qishan, and Baoji counties suffered drought; Wusa, Wumeng, Yizhou, Mangbu, Dongchuan, and other routes suffered famine and epidemic — all were given relief.

s0323.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinyou day: the Jiang-Huai and other places Chief Wealth Tax Commissioner's Office was abolished.
s0323.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, xinyou day: the Jiang-Huai and other places chief wealth tax commissioner's office was abolished.

s0324.literal: On guihai day Prince Hezan dispatched envoys from the Western Regions presenting rare goods.
s0324.idiomatic: On guihai day Prince Hezan dispatched envoys from the Western Regions presenting rare goods.

s0325.literal: Princes Yesun Temür and others were granted two hundred thousand ingots of notes; northern frontier qianhu fifteen thousand ingots; qielian retainers and others more than ninety thousand ingots; Prince of Xiping Aoluchi twenty thousand ingots.
s0325.idiomatic: Princes Yesun Temür and others were granted 200,000 ingots of notes; northern frontier qianhu 15,000 ingots; qielian retainers and others more than 90,000 ingots; Prince of Xiping Aoluchi 20,000 ingots.

s0326.literal: Because Shunde and Enzhou suffered continuous rain last year, more than four thousand shi of their people's rent was remitted.
s0326.idiomatic: Because Shunde and Enzhou suffered continuous rain last year, more than 4,000 shi of their people's rent was remitted.

s0327.literal: Eighth month: Jiaocheng, Yangqu, and Guanzhou in Taiyuan, Lanzhou, Huairen in Datong — rain, hail, and frost killing grain; Hangzhou suffered fire — grain was issued for relief.
s0327.idiomatic: Eighth month: Jiaocheng, Yangqu, and Guanzhou in Taiyuan, Lanzhou, Huairen in Datong — rain, hail, and frost killing grain; Hangzhou suffered fire — grain was issued for relief.

s0328.literal: Because Daming and Gaotang suffered continuous rain last year, more than twenty-four thousand shi of field rent was remitted.
s0328.idiomatic: Because Daming and Gaotang suffered continuous rain last year, more than 24,000 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0329.literal: Ninth month, guichou day: the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0329.idiomatic: Ninth month, guichou day: the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0330.literal: On gengshen day Bayan and Liang Degui were both restored as central secretariat grand councillors; Badughachi as central secretariat right vice chancellor; Merihuoer as central secretariat associate administrator; pingzhang of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat Ali was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0330.idiomatic: On gengshen day Bayan and Liang Degui were both restored as central secretariat grand councillors; Badughachi as central secretariat right vice chancellor; Merihuoer as central secretariat associate administrator; pingzhang of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat Ali was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0331.literal: On gengwu day Zhang You, minister of revenue, was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0331.idiomatic: On gengwu day Zhang You, minister of revenue, was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0332.literal: On guiyou day princes Chabaer, Duowa, and others dispatched envoys to come and submit; six hundred bolts of silk were granted them.
s0332.idiomatic: On guiyou day princes Chabaer, Duowa, and others dispatched envoys to come and submit; 600 bolts of silk were granted them.

s0333.literal: An edict directed that whenever princes drew on treasury funds, they must not advance loans without imperial command.
s0333.idiomatic: An edict directed that whenever princes drew on treasury funds, they must not advance loans without imperial command.

s0334.literal: Four hundred bolts of silk were granted to Prince Chuban's subjects.
s0334.idiomatic: 400 bolts of silk were granted to Prince Chuban's subjects.

s0335.literal: Garrison troops of Sichuan and Yunnan whose families resided in Taiyuan and Pingyang and suffered disaster were granted notes in graded amounts.
s0335.idiomatic: Garrison troops of Sichuan and Yunnan whose families resided in Taiyuan and Pingyang and suffered disaster were granted notes in graded amounts.

s0336.literal: A hurricane arose in Chaozhou, the sea overflowed, drifting away commoners' houses; many drowned — affected households were granted two months' grain.
s0336.idiomatic: A hurricane arose in Chaozhou, the sea overflowed, drifting away commoners' houses; many drowned — affected households were granted two months' grain.

s0337.literal: Because Ji, Meng, Hui, and Yunnei prefectures suffered continuous rain last year, twenty-two thousand one hundred shi of field rent was remitted.
s0337.idiomatic: Because Ji, Meng, Hui, and Yunnei prefectures suffered continuous rain last year, 22,100 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0338.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinmao day: ceremonies were held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0338.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, xinmao day: ceremonies were held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0339.literal: On xinsi day Prince Azhiji's subjects were granted three thousand nine hundred ingots of notes as horse-fodder price payments.
s0339.idiomatic: On xinsi day Prince Azhiji's subjects were granted 3,900 ingots of notes as horse-fodder price payments.

s0340.literal: Palace provision commissioner and chief protector Changshou was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Shaanxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor Toghan was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0340.idiomatic: Palace provision commissioner and chief protector Changshou was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Shaanxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor Toghan was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0341.literal: On dinghai day Annam dispatched envoys to present tribute.
s0341.idiomatic: On dinghai day Annam dispatched envoys to present tribute.

s0342.literal: An edict directed that princes and imperial sons-in-law must not use relay stations to go hunting.
s0342.idiomatic: An edict directed that princes and imperial sons-in-law must not use relay stations to go hunting.

s0343.literal: On gengyin day the imperial nephew Khayishan was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaining; a gold seal was granted; still sixty-five thousand households of Ruizhou were carved off and placed under him; each year five-household silk tribute of two thousand six hundred ingots of notes and one thousand bolts each of brocade were granted.
s0343.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial nephew Khayishan was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaining; a gold seal was granted; still 65,000 households of Ruizhou were carved off and placed under him; each year five-household silk tribute of 2,600 ingots of notes and 1,000 bolts each of brocade were granted.

s0344.literal: On wuxu day officials of the secretariat, censorate, and privy council were ordered to try Koryo chancellor Wu Qi and qianhu Shi Tianfu — because Qi alienated the king father and son, and Tianfu plotted to return to Japan — both were flogged and exiled to Anxi.
s0344.idiomatic: On wuxu day officials of the secretariat, censorate, and privy council were ordered to try Koryo chancellor Wu Qi and qianhu Shi Tianfu — because Qi alienated the king father and son, and Tianfu plotted to return to Japan — both were flogged and exiled to Anxi.

s0345.literal: Eleventh month, renzi day, an edict directed: "Within inner circuits and Jiangnan, whenever Han people are thrice tattooed as thieves, they are banished to garrison Liaoyang;
s0345.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renzi day, an edict directed, "Within inner circuits and Jiangnan, whenever Han people are thrice tattooed as thieves, they are banished to garrison Liaoyang;

s0346.literal: persons of other categories and Koryo, thrice exempt from tattoo, banished to garrison Huguang;
s0346.idiomatic: persons of other categories and Koryo, thrice exempt from tattoo, banished to garrison Huguang;

s0347.literal: those who steal forbidden fine horses — first offense banished to garrison, second offense death.
s0347.idiomatic: those who steal forbidden fine horses — first offense banished to garrison, second offense death.

s0348.literal: " Because Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered great earthquakes last year, their taxes and levies were remitted for one year.
s0348.idiomatic: Because Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered great earthquakes last year, their taxes and levies were remitted for one year.

s0349.literal: Control Use Bureau envoy Hulin and Hanlin direct academician Lin Yuan were dispatched to console Koryo.
s0349.idiomatic: Control Use Bureau envoy Hulin and Hanlin direct academician Lin Yuan were dispatched to console Koryo.

s0350.literal: Three hundred ninety households of Liaoyang commoners conscripted as soldiers, including Leyi, were restored to civilian registration.
s0350.idiomatic: 390 households of Liaoyang commoners conscripted as soldiers, including Leyi, were restored to civilian registration.

s0351.literal: On dingmao day monks' rents were again remitted.
s0351.idiomatic: On dingmao day monks' rents were again remitted.

s0352.literal: On wuchen day armory director Tegudar was made censor-in-chief.
s0352.idiomatic: On wuchen day armory director Tegudar was made censor-in-chief.

s0353.literal: On renshen day an edict directed that whenever monks commit adultery, theft, or murder, local officials were to decide exclusively.
s0353.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict directed that whenever monks commit adultery, theft, or murder, local officials were to decide exclusively.

s0354.literal: Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu supplied more than ten thousand five hundred horses to the army; an order directed twenty-five thousand two hundred fifty-odd ingots of notes be granted as payment.
s0354.idiomatic: Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu supplied more than 10,500 horses to the army; an order directed 25,250-odd ingots of notes be granted as payment.

s0355.literal: Sea-transport grain was increased to one million seven hundred thousand shi.
s0355.idiomatic: Sea-transport grain was increased to 1,700,000 shi.

s0356.literal: Twelfth month, gengzi day: the Yidu gold-panning chief commissioner's office was re-established.
s0356.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengzi day: the Yidu gold-panning chief commissioner's office was re-established.

s0357.literal: On xinchou day Prince Chuban was enfeoffed as Prince of Weiwu Xining; a gold seal was granted.
s0357.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince Chuban was enfeoffed as Prince of Weiwu Xining; a gold seal was granted.

s0358.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda, princes Azhiji, Yesu Bugan, and others were granted fourteen thousand ingots of notes.
s0358.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda, princes Azhiji, Yesu Bugan, and others were granted 14,000 ingots of notes.

s0359.literal: Year 9, spring, first month, dingsi day: the Moon transgressed Heaven's Gate.
s0359.idiomatic: Year 9, spring, first month, dingsi day: the moon transgressed Heaven's Gate.

s0360.literal: On wuwu day Imperial Preceptor Rinchen Gyaltsen died; burial gifts of five hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, ten thousand bolts of brocade, and three thousand ingots of notes were granted; a pagoda and monastery were still built.
s0360.idiomatic: On wuwu day Imperial Preceptor Rinchen Gyaltsen died; burial gifts of 500 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, 10,000 bolts of brocade, and 3,000 ingots of notes were granted; a pagoda and monastery were still built.

s0361.literal: On jiazi day the Moon transgressed Bright Hall.
s0361.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Bright Hall.

s0362.literal: Zhang Daonu and others of the Onggirad, formerly provisionally assigned as soldiers, were restored to civilian registration.
s0362.idiomatic: Zhang Daonu and others of the Onggirad, formerly provisionally assigned as soldiers, were restored to civilian registration.

s0363.literal: On jisi day the Moon transgressed Eastern Door.
s0363.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon transgressed Eastern Door.

s0364.literal: On renshen day the wine prohibition in Dadu was lifted.
s0364.idiomatic: On renshen day the wine prohibition in Dadu was lifted.

s0365.literal: On jiaxu day princes Gammala, Sadurshar, Babuhua, and their subjects were granted fifty-six thousand nine hundred ingots of notes and brocade in graded amounts; falconers and others one million five hundred thousand ingots.
s0365.idiomatic: On jiaxu day princes Gammala, Sadurshar, Babuhua, and their subjects were granted 56,900 ingots of notes and brocade in graded amounts; falconers and others 1,500,000 ingots.

s0366.literal: Second month, guiwei day: an edict directed that soldier-artisan households originally subordinate to the Eastern Palace must not be seized by local offices.
s0366.idiomatic: Second month, guiwei day: an edict directed that soldier-artisan households originally subordinate to the Eastern Palace must not be seized by local offices.

s0367.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Recently close attendants have transmitted commands from within; all appointments, rewards, and punishments have no written record — we fear there may be discrepancies; we ask that from now on those transmitting commands all furnish written records to the central secretariat.
s0367.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Recently close attendants have transmitted commands from within; all appointments, rewards, and punishments have no written record — we fear there may be discrepancies; we ask that from now on those transmitting commands all furnish written records to the central secretariat.

s0369.literal: On jiawu day taxes and levies on Daoists throughout the realm were remitted.
s0369.idiomatic: On jiawu day taxes and levies on Daoists throughout the realm were remitted.

s0370.literal: On yiwei day the Great Tian Shou Wan Ning Monastery was built.
s0370.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Great Tian Shou Wan Ning Monastery was built.

s0371.literal: On dingyou day Prince Gammala was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei'an; Prince of Dingyuan Yemuhu'er as Prince of Weiding — both were granted gold seals.
s0371.idiomatic: On dingyou day Prince Gammala was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei'an; Prince of Dingyuan Yemuhu'er as Prince of Weiding — both were granted gold seals.

s0372.literal: The Hanlin Dynastic History Academy was promoted to rank 2a; the Duowa envoy was granted five hundred bolts of brocade.
s0372.idiomatic: The Hanlin dynastic history academy was promoted to rank 2a; the Duowa envoy was granted 500 bolts of brocade.

s0373.literal: On gengzi day the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on performing suburban sacrifice rites.
s0373.idiomatic: On gengzi day the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on performing suburban sacrifice rites.

s0374.literal: On xinchou day an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm.
s0374.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm.

s0375.literal: The censorate, Hanlin, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and Six Ministries — each within rank 5 and above — were to recommend three persons of integrity, ability, and governance; branch secretariats, branch censorates, pacification commissions, and surveillance commissions five each.
s0375.idiomatic: The censorate, Hanlin, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and Six Ministries — each within rank 5 and above — were to recommend three persons of integrity, ability, and governance; branch secretariats, branch censorates, pacification commissions, and surveillance commissions five each.

s0376.literal: Corvée taxes in Dadu, Shangdu, and Longxing and package-silver salary notes in inner circuits were remitted for one year.
s0376.idiomatic: Corvée taxes in Dadu, Shangdu, and Longxing and package-silver salary notes in inner circuits were remitted for one year.

s0377.literal: Rent levies south of the Yangtze and Huai and those tenant-farming official fields were uniformly remitted two-tenths.
s0377.idiomatic: Rent levies south of the Yangtze and Huai and those tenant-farming official fields were uniformly remitted two-tenths.

s0378.literal: Retired officials with only one son eligible for inherited privilege had corvée missions remitted as well; those with impoverished households received half salary for life.
s0378.idiomatic: Retired officials with only one son eligible for inherited privilege had corvée missions remitted as well; those with impoverished households received half salary for life.

s0379.literal: On bingwu day qielian retainers of the palace guard were granted one million ingots of notes.
s0379.idiomatic: On bingwu day qielian retainers of the palace guard were granted 1,000,000 ingots of notes.

s0380.literal: Because Guide suffered repeated flooding and the people were famished, two months' grain was granted.
s0380.idiomatic: Because Guide suffered repeated flooding and the people were famished, two months' grain was granted.

s0381.literal: Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered earthquakes; disaster-afflicted relay households were granted twelve thousand five hundred ingots of notes.
s0381.idiomatic: Pingyang and Taiyuan suffered earthquakes; disaster-afflicted relay households were granted 12,500 ingots of notes.

s0382.literal: Third month, dingwei new moon: the imperial carriage departed for Shangdu.
s0382.idiomatic: Third month, dingwei new moon: the imperial carriage departed for Shangdu.

s0383.literal: Accumulated years' worth of reduced annual grants to the Prince of Anxi — five hundred taels of gold and eleven thousand nine hundred jin of silk — were restored; his subjects were still granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0383.idiomatic: Accumulated years' worth of reduced annual grants to the Prince of Anxi — 500 taels of gold and 11,900 jin of silk — were restored; his subjects were still granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0384.literal: An edict directed Liaoyang branch secretariat not to decide capital cases independently; brocade stored at Karakorum was granted to garrison troops under the Prince of Huaining.
s0384.idiomatic: An edict directed Liaoyang branch secretariat not to decide capital cases independently; brocade stored at Karakorum was granted to garrison troops under the Prince of Huaining.

s0385.literal: On gengxu day Xiangjiaban, nephew of Khalaj Baghshi, was made imperial preceptor.
s0385.idiomatic: On gengxu day Xiangjiaban, nephew of Khalaj Baghshi, was made imperial preceptor.

s0386.literal: An edict directed the Prince of Liang not to interfere in Yunnan branch secretariat affairs; one thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0386.idiomatic: An edict directed the Prince of Liang not to interfere in Yunnan branch secretariat affairs; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0387.literal: On jiayin day Mars transgressed Di.
s0387.idiomatic: On jiayin day Mars transgressed Di.

s0388.literal: On wuwu day Jupiter transgressed Left Law.
s0388.idiomatic: On wuwu day Jupiter transgressed Left Law.

s0389.literal: Privy council vice commissioner Gao Xing was made grand councillor, still retaining privy council vice commissioner.
s0389.idiomatic: Privy council vice commissioner Gao Xing was made grand councillor, still retaining privy council vice commissioner.

s0390.literal: Prince Totoq was granted two thousand ingots of notes; Nu'ulun, Boluo, and others five hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, and twenty thousand ingots of notes.
s0390.idiomatic: Prince Totoq was granted 2,000 ingots of notes; Nu'ulun, Boluo, and others 500 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, and 20,000 ingots of notes.

s0391.literal: Because Jining suffered continuous rain last year damaging crops and Changning Prefecture suffered famine — both were given relief.
s0391.idiomatic: Because Jining suffered continuous rain last year damaging crops and Changning Prefecture suffered famine — both were given relief.

s0392.literal: Counties subordinate to Hejian, Yidu, and Panyang — frost killed mulberry trees — consolation was granted.
s0392.idiomatic: Counties subordinate to Hejian, Yidu, and Panyang — frost killed mulberry trees — consolation was granted.

s0393.literal: Yihuang and Daye in Xingguo suffered fire — affected persons were granted one month's grain.
s0393.idiomatic: Yihuang and Daye in Xingguo suffered fire — affected persons were granted one month's grain.

s0394.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengchen day: the Moon transgressed Well.
s0394.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, gengchen day: the moon transgressed Well.

s0395.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat requested additional garrison troops — not permitted; envoys were dispatched to every route to inspect those due for garrison and dispatch them.
s0395.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat requested additional garrison troops — not permitted; envoys were dispatched to every route to inspect those due for garrison and dispatch them.

s0396.literal: On yiyou day Datong Route suffered an earthquake with a sound like thunder; more than five thousand government and common buildings collapsed; more than two thousand people were crushed to death.
s0396.idiomatic: On yiyou day Datong Route suffered an earthquake with a sound like thunder; more than 5,000 government and common buildings collapsed; more than 2,000 people were crushed to death.

s0397.literal: The ground split in two places in Huairen County; water gushed out entirely black, floating up decayed pine and cypress wood; envoys were dispatched with four thousand ingots of notes and more than twenty-five thousand shi of rice for relief.
s0397.idiomatic: The ground split in two places in Huairen County; water gushed out entirely black, floating up decayed pine and cypress wood; envoys were dispatched with 4,000 ingots of notes and more than 25,000 shi of rice for relief.

s0398.literal: That year's rent, levies, taxes, and corvée were all remitted.
s0398.idiomatic: That year's rent, levies, taxes, and corvée were all remitted.

s0399.literal: On wuzi day the envoys dispatched by Chabaer and Duowa were granted one thousand four hundred taels of silver and more than seven thousand eight hundred ingots of notes.
s0399.idiomatic: On wuzi day the envoys dispatched by Chabaer and Duowa were granted 1,400 taels of silver and more than 7,800 ingots of notes.

s0400.literal: On jichou day the Dongchuan Route barbarian official A Kui presented two hundred fifty horses, two hundred fifty taels of gold, and local products as tribute.
s0400.idiomatic: On jichou day the Dongchuan Route barbarian official A Kui presented 250 horses, 250 taels of gold, and local products as tribute.
